subject: [hw] V03→IV: vendor unresolved count with V30 shims = 111 (data table still required)
body: Loader+V30 integration datapoint for n2vhost (no action required): linking the real loader (loader/n2elf.c + n2elf_reloc.c) with V02's emu core/mem and V30's shim/n2shim_string.c + n2shim_format.c + n2shim_heap.c, registering n2shim_string[] + n2shim_heap[] + a two-entry data table (__stack_chk_guard 4, stderr 4), the five vendor objects link with unresolved=111 (down from 146; V30 covers 35 imports). So the remaining function imports to cover with V32/V33/V34 are 111 for this set. Reminder from my earlier note: without the data table, n2elf_link fails on __stack_chk_guard before any function shim matters, so add n2shim_data_all before link even if V34 is late (a local 2-entry table is enough for M-a/M-b).
